about.description: ETF perpetual market on Ondo Perps tracking the iShares MSCI South Korea ETF, cash-settled, 24/7, up to 20x leverage, margined in USDC. Users get linear price exposure only - no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Adapter snapshot 2026-08-19: mark $174.9000, open interest $199.93K, 24h volume $561.91K. Added 2026-08-19 to reconcile the registry with Ondo's stated 35 RWA markets; the adapter's 40 rows include 5 crypto perps (BTC, ETH, SOL, HYPE, ONDO) that are out of scope.
